summary: A short bonus reading of MTG, the 2023 memoir of Republican congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, covering its chapters on offshoring, impeaching Biden over the border and fentanyl, the media, January 6 and Covid masking.

evidence.note: episode announced as a reading of the congresswoman's book
publisher identified as a Trump-family vanity press; hosts discuss its owners
host explains bulk buying of politicians' books as a form of payment
impeachment chapter blames Biden for cartel fentanyl; host argues drug policy
media chapter praises Tucker Carlson and attacks The View
January 6 chapter downplays the riot and defends those charged
long Covid chapter with anti-mask claims; hosts check her linked sources
book refers to the 2023 Tucker Carlson firing as recent, dating it to 2023

notes: Title misspells Greene. Book publication year (2023) inferred from the Tucker firing reference and outside knowledge; Sophie obtained a signed copy at the 2024 RNC (framing anecdote, not counted in covered_span). Sophie reads the book and acts as co-host but is a producer, so not listed as a guest. Short, digressive episode; themes are each only a few minutes. Lifetime rule not applied (media-reading).
